name: MapQuest
tagline: Mapping, geocoding, directions, and place search APIs for location-aware applications
description: MapQuest provides REST APIs for geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing/directions, static and interactive maps, place search, and traffic data. Developers authenticate with a self-serve API key and call endpoints under mapquestapi.com. The platform is widely used for address validation, turn-by-turn directions, and embedding maps without building a full mapping stack.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (e.g. ?key=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve signup at developer.mapquest.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — verify current free tier on developer.mapquest.com pricing

use_cases: geocode an address to lat/lng coordinates
get driving directions between two points
reverse-geocode coordinates to a street address
generate a static map image for a location
search for nearby places by category
